title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor

suppliers.sup:70510: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: 2027 motor pricing — committee review
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Forecast fc:350011@2026-09 records volume growth of 11.9%, supporting better fixed-cost absorption. Could you review €355.00 per unit, 60 days net, with a fixed price and no index clause for the full annual commitment?

Annual-review record doc:20260410-70510-M1 states that changes above 2% require pricing-committee approval; please arrange an authorized review of this package.

Could you also explain how copper purchasing dates and any hedging affect the increase actually applicable to 2027 deliveries? We seek a sustainable agreement rather than automatic pass-through of spot movements.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: 2027 motor pricing — committee review
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have incorporated the verified volume growth into our calculation, allowing us to adjust our offer accordingly. The substantial increase in copper costs remains a critical factor that volume alone cannot offset. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Our offer is a price of €371.81 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We must maintain our standard 30 days net payment terms to support this pricing, as extended terms would necessitate a price increase. Alternatively, at our standard terms, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €369.76 per unit, no Preisgleitklausel.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Legal Department: As key account managers for Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG, we can offer a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION, CU-NOTATION, CU-NOTATION.

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

messages.subject: 2027 motor agreement – payment-term review
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for reviewing the annual commitment. We respect that your detailed calculation remains internal.

Could your pricing committee authorize €369.76 per unit with 60 days net, fixed for the full year without indexation? Alternatively, could you retain €371.81 and extend payment to 90 days?

Both packages retain the full annual volume and agreed delivery arrangements. Please identify which package you can support sustainably and make the more economical approved package your primary offer. If neither is feasible, what is your smallest required adjustment for 90-day payment?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: 2027 motor agreement – payment-term review
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We have reviewed your proposals regarding extended payment terms. Based on our general terms and pricing guidelines, our Angebot comprises a price of €371.25 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 60 days net, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

messages.subject: Annual fixed-price agreement: payment-term review
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Forecast fc:350011@2026-06 recorded growth of 9.7%, supporting our request to recognize the increased annual commitment.

Our supplier-specific should-cost estimate cost:350011 is €374.95 per unit, but its confidence is only 5%; we do not regard it as your verified cost or floor.

Could your pricing committee and Credit Control approve €371.25 with 90 days net and no indexation? If financing prevents this, what is the smallest price adjustment needed for 90 days? Please also confirm whether your current fixed-price offer supports sustainable supply throughout the contract; we are not requesting disclosure of private margins.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: Annual fixed-price agreement: payment-term review
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Please note that the volume growth you referenced was already incorporated into our previous calculation; we have already taken that volume change data into account. 

We can accommodate your request for a 90-day payment term with an adjusted price of €372.85 per unit. We confirm that our fixed-price calculation ensures a sustainable supply throughout the contract duration. Consequently, our current Angebot is a price of €372.85 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
